endpoints.description: URLs of the mirror's endpoints, which chalkd and containerd try in order before the registry itself. A path is where the endpoint serves the registry API, below <path>/v2 as containerd takes it. chalkd authenticates to an endpoint with the Registry of the endpoint's host, and an http:// endpoint needs that Registry to set insecure.

registry.description: Host of the registry as image references name it, with its port unless it is 443; an IPv6 address in brackets.

rules.messageExpression: "the Mirror documents " + documents.filter(n, documents.exists(m, m != n && documents[m].spec.registry == documents[n].spec.registry)).join(", ") + " mirror the same registry; give one Mirror per registry"
rules.rule: documents.all(n, documents.all(m, n == m || documents[n].spec.registry != documents[m].spec.registry))
